__NOTOC__
<quote by="Announced by Dima Vasilyevna Novosad, Master of the Koboldi">The people of Karov wish to self fund and build a great market in Delev. This will provide the Senate four additional thrones per season in tax (and assorted local benefits!). This is time sensitive to this summit only!
</quote>
==Overview==
* Constructs a [[great work]] in Duzekani, Karov, as per the '''[[Outside_the_wall#A_Great_Market|Outside the wall]]''' wind of fortune. 
* Announcement by the [[Master of the Koboldi]]

==Date==
* Spring 388YE

==Cost==
* Costs as per opportunity
* 50 wains of white granite
* 150 crowns in labour costs
* Three months to construct

==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Construct_Delev_Grand_Market}}
==Outcome==
Once complete, the grand market will have the following effects:
* Raises the level of investment in businesses in Karov by one
* Allows citizens to take a business in Karov for free for one year after completion
* Adds an additional purchase rank to the [[Bargainer of the Iron Tower|Iron Tower]], [[Harbourmaster of the Semmerlak|Korotny Docks]] and the [[Overseer of the Westward Road|Delev Market]]
* Increases taxation of Karov by an additional 4 thrones a season if the Little Boyar's Welcome is also upgraded
* Would allow Senate to use a motion to permit the Boyar of the Iron Roads to create a sinecure instead of a ministry each season without using a Senate commission
